cases.userText: Where is the documentation for coupon codes?
cases.conversation: USER: Where is the documentation for coupon codes?
cases.draft: The complete guide is at https://docs.northstar.test/guides/coupon-codes-v2/ and the advanced stacking guide is at https://docs.northstar.test/extensions/coupon-stacking/. Both are current as of version 4.2.
cases.note: Two fabricated links and one unsupported version claim.

cases.userText: Is there an event that fires when a subscription expires?
cases.conversation: USER: Is there an event that fires when a subscription expires?
cases.toolSummary: search_api_docs: subscription.expired fires after expiration is recorded. Callback receives the subscription object.
cases.draft: Yes. Use subscription.expired; it runs after expiration is recorded and passes the subscription object to the callback.
cases.note: Every claim is grounded in tool evidence.

cases.userText: Should I use Form Extras to collect a phone number during signup?
cases.conversation: USER: Should I use Form Extras to collect a phone number during signup?
cases.toolSummary: search_docs: Form Extras is deprecated. Built-in Profile Fields replaces it.
cases.draft: Form Extras is still the recommended extension for signup phone fields. Install it, then add the field under Settings → Form Extras.
cases.note: Recommendation contradicts evidence and invents a configuration path.

cases.userText: Could changing the collation fix these invalid-string errors?
cases.conversation: USER: Could changing the collation fix these invalid-string errors?
cases.draft: It could help if incompatible table collations are the cause, but that is only one possibility. I would inspect the affected columns and incoming character data before treating it as the fix.
cases.note: Appropriately hedged analysis should pass.

cases.userText: Checkout says the selected price is inactive. What could be wrong?
cases.conversation: USER: Checkout says the selected price is inactive. What could be wrong?
cases.draft: This is definitely a core bug in build_checkout_price() at line 918; it never checks price.active. Tell the customer to delete the inactive price and we will ship the fix in 4.2.1 tomorrow. The coupon system always archives old prices automatically.
cases.note: Specific code, remediation, release, and behavior claims lack evidence.
